takes.prompt: The same long loose black-haired drummer plays a continuous repeated hi-hat/snare rock phrase around118BPM, exactly TWO separate sticks held one per hand. Compact alternating strokes approach real drum/cymbal surfaces, make plausible contact and rebound. During roughly the first third his stroke height and shoulder energy remain restrained; toward the final two thirds his accents grow stronger and slightly broader while still reachable and coordinated, giving the later kept section greater force. Never trade or multiply sticks, ghost the wrists or pass tips through rims. Preserve the seated body, black ornate jacket/goatee/hoops, black five-piece kit, chrome stands and stable supported drum topology. Actual hand/stick playing, not one slow raised-arm gesture or head-only movement. Detailed hand-drawn anime style and a steady camera. Preserve face, hair, costume, natural finger count, connected wrists/arms and supported instruments. Performance movement must continue throughout rather than a camera move, held pose or single slow flourish. The steady rock pulse around118BPM is art direction, not a claim of exact note/beat sync. No extra figures, duplicated limbs, instrument morphing, or source-frame looping.
